page.overview:
Who is September?

September is a male Earth pony who appears in the IDW comics, typically in the background of comic panels.

September is a reference to the Fringe character of the same name, who is one of the Observers—evolved humans that can travel through time and space. His lack of visible tail hair is akin to the Observers' baldness, and his random appearances in the comics also allude to the Observers' appearances at key points in Fringe's history. He is similar to Issue 15 Unnamed Stallion - Binoculars and "Slendermane". Prior to the creation of Fringe, G1 My Little Pony introduced an elf character named September.

September's appearances are added by artist Andy Price, including a speaking role as part of an unscripted scene in the story Reflections Part 1.

In the story arc The Return of Queen Chrysalis, September appears on page 17 of Issue #1, after the changelings' invasion of Ponyville is thwarted; on page 20 of Issue #2, when the Mane 6 are traveling through the Forest of Leota; on page 11 of Issue #3, when Twilight Sparkle and Fluttershy are traveling through the forest by themselves; and on page 21 of Issue #4, when the ponies, Spike, and Princess Celestia are at a campfire.
